Elena / team,

Attaching the operator evidence bundle and a short operator-to-region mapping (operator_evidence_bundle.zip, kv-cache-operator-list.txt). Summary below for quick consumption:

- AWS (us-west-2): compute + KV cache. Access: Redwood runtime service accounts + internal KMS. SOC2 excerpt included; encryption-at-rest AES-256. Replication to eu-west is async for analytics only; no KV material is replicated.
- GCP (europe-west1): telemetry and analytics snapshots. No KV access. We maintain region-specific key rotation logs (enclosed).
- EdgeOps Inc. (APAC): operator for edge inference nodes. They run containerized serving in customer-provisioned clusters; they do not have access to customer encryption keys. We can provide onboarding logs and a signed DPA; typical onboarding time is 7 business days.
- NodeGrid (global): handles TLS termination and traffic routing. They never persist PII beyond transient caches; their proxy layer is covered by our contractual appendix.
- TelemetryHub: collects anonymized metrics, no PII retention.

Change-notice practice: default public announcement + customer email 30 days prior for infra tooling; operator swaps that affect live traffic trigger a 60-day notice with an emergency rollback window. For contractual SLAs on MTTA/MTTR we provide 24-hour initial response and a remediation plan; specifics can be added to an addendum.

Ive included short excerpts from SOC2 and a machine-readable list of KV-access operators in kv-cache-operator-list.txt. If FinSecure needs any additional evidence (full SOC2 report under NDA, penetration-test summaries, or HSM/KMS configuration prints), we can arrange a controlled share.

Let me know if you want a combined zip or separate links.
